text: As required by the City's Investment Policy, the purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Investment Board with the following: 1. The performance of the Sinking Fund and Long Term Fund for the first quarter of 2021. 2. Investment Policy and Plan Compliance certificates and reports for the first quarter of 2021.
The Toronto Investment Board received the report (May 17, 2021) from the Director, Capital Markets for information.
